brief:
Germany's foreign ministry regards U.S. President Donald Trump's latest Gaza plan as an opportunity to advance towards the disarmament of Hamas, according to Al-Monitor. A German government spokesperson made the statement on Monday in response to questions about the American initiative.

The characterization reflects Berlin's initial assessment of Trump's proposal for resolving the conflict. Germany has designated Hamas as a terrorist organization and views the plan as potentially opening diplomatic pathways toward reducing the group's military capabilities in Gaza.
